text_block_list.text:
During our meeting, Biko Pegasus was 
holding her head in visible pain.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... A hero can heal something like 
this with pure fighting spirit... 
Ow-ow-ow..."

...I was concerned, so I looked up foods 
that help with migraines online and found 
that foods containing vitamin B2 are 
effective.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Vitamin B2? What should I eat to get 
that...?
choice_data_list:
Maybe cheese, liver, milk, that sort of 
thing?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I hate milk... so I always left it 
uneaten. I wonder if that's why my head 
started hurting..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...All right, decided! I'm gonna drink 
some milk and blow this headache right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Watch me, Trainer! A hero never runs away 
from things they struggle with!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Bleh, I knew it, no way...! Why does 
milk have to smell like this?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Uuuugh... My head is starting to hurt 
even more..."

And so, Biko Pegasus was plagued by a 
headache...
